question: If (1)/(x²+a²)= x² - a², then the value of x is :
solution:
Given:

 (1)/(x²+a²)= x2 - a2

Concept used:

a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b)

Calculation:

 (1)/(x²+a²)= x2 - a2

⇒ (x2 - a2)(x2 + a2) = 1

⇒ x⁴ - a⁴ = 1

⇒ x⁴ = 1 + a⁴

⇒ x = (a4 + 1)1/4

**∴ The value of x is (a4 + 1)1/4.**
